extraLines: Source conflict 2026-08-30: https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/core/README.md still words Final as acceptance by a majority of validators, while https://developers.stellar.org/docs/learn/fundamentals/stellar-consensus-protocol defines quorum-set/FBA agreement; the answer keeps FBA activation semantics and the registry wording is a simplification, not a contradiction.

Source conflict 2026-08-30: https://stellar.org/grants-and-funding says students and researchers can earn academic grants, while the dedicated https://research.stellar.org/research-grants page and https://github.com/stellar/research/blob/main/docs/research-grants/index.md require a degree-granting institution and PI and pay awards to institutions only; the dedicated program page controls and the answer already encodes it.

Source conflict 2026-08-30: https://stellar.org/grants-and-funding/bug-bounty still says two Immunefi bounties are supported, while https://hackerone.com/stellar?view_policy=true states the general Stellar Immunefi program is deprecated and https://immunefi.com/bug-bounty/stellar/information/ returns Not Found; the OpenZeppelin-on-Stellar Immunefi program remains live and independent, as the answer states.

Source conflict 2026-08-30: https://stellar.org/grants-and-funding says there is no application for the Enterprise Fund, while https://stellar.org/enterprise-fund/apply exposes a current application form; the answer already requires disclosing this intake conflict and routing through the dedicated form.
